verdict.rationale: A payments platform that holds merchant and transaction data could plausibly offer an AI-training opt-out, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training data use, opt-out controls, or a data-usage policy. The MCP server, agent toolkit and LLM-friendly docs are about AI integration, not training-data privacy, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
